api_start: systemctl --user reset-failed kv-laguna-api 2>/dev/null; systemctl --user is-active -q kv-laguna-api || systemd-run --user --unit=kv-laguna-api -p MemoryMax=2G -p MemorySwapMax=0 --working-directory=$HOME/laguna-kv-api bash -c 'exec ./bin/sparkpipe_model_api --deployment model_resident.json --runtime-root $HOME/laguna-kv-api/runtime --port 8472 >> api.log 2>&1' >/dev/null
api_stop: systemctl --user stop kv-laguna-api 2>/dev/null; systemctl --user reset-failed kv-laguna-api 2>/dev/null; true
